design_fields.q1_rationale: The study does not specify how plausible values were handled, leaving it unclear whether they were used correctly.
design_fields.q2_rationale: The study uses PISA microdata but does not mention whether sampling weights were applied in the analysis.
design_fields.q3_rationale: The study appears to use student-level models without addressing school clustering, as there is no mention of multilevel modeling or cluster-robust standard errors.
design_fields.q4_rationale: The study does not mention any external validation methods and focuses solely on internal validation techniques.
